cases.name: Lizbeth Medina
cases.about: Lizbeth was a cheerleader at Edna High School who had dreams of becoming a nurse, said her aunt Ana Medina. Raised by a single mother, she was close to her grandparents, aunts and uncles. They said that whenever Lizbeth cheered for her high school football team, her face lit up with joy. "Lizbeth was outgoing and confident — someone willing to take off her shirt to give it to someone else. She was always there for everybody — charming, young, and full of energy. That was all just cut short," the aunt added.
cases.narrative: On 12/5/2023, her mother found her stabbed to death, still in her pajamas because she had been getting ready for school, in their home bathtub. Edna Police Department Detective Stacy Cavazos said that Rafael Govea Romero, 23, visited Lizbeth Medina’s apartment home “several times” before her murder on Dec. 5, including a drive through the apartment grounds the previous evening. The detective added that Romero exhibited “stalking-like behavior” during his repeated visits, according to the Victoria Advocate.
